summary: pykernel confines every Python kernel before the first instruction of user code: Landlock (ABI >= 6) limits files to read-only runtime paths and a read-write session workdir, denies TCP and scopes abstract unix sockets and signals; seccomp refuses socket creation, ptrace, namespaces, mount, bpf, keyrings, perf, io_uring, process_vm_* and setsid/setpgid; no_new_privs and an empty capability set; the shim sets AS/CPU/FSIZE/NPROC/NOFILE itself. New isolation.Check reports which boundaries are really in force (verified in a child); manager.New fails closed with the missing list (isolation.Profile{Mode: ModeInsecureDisabled} opts out for development), and every kernel must report the same boundaries in a kernel.ready handshake. New pkg/pykernel/conformance suite and cmd/pykernel-conformance for consumers. Kernels get default limits, a server wall-clock cap and a workdir quota (bytes and entries, for the kernel's whole life; Acquire returns ErrWorkdirQuota for an over-entries workdir); EventDone now carries Reason (completed/error/cancelled/timeout/quota_exceeded/kernel_exited), EventsDropped, NamespaceReset and FilesPreserved; the bridge never blocks on a stalled consumer; exec cancellation and timeouts always cancel capability calls, and calls outside the running exec are refused; Session may implement CallContextBinder for the user identity; lifecycle FreshNamespace is enforced; WarmPool evicts the LRU idle kernel at MaxParallel; reuse across tenants or modes returns ErrSessionMismatch. Breaking: the shim moves to a host-owned runtime directory and the bridge.Bridge interface gains ResetNamespace. Review hardening: every address-bearing socket call is refused; the workdir quota is enforced at allocation time by a host supervisor over seccomp user notification that performs every write-family call itself (pidfd_getfd, fixed checked offset, blocks plus entries, unlinked and mapped files charged, killable waits); no thread or process starts while no exec runs and idle CPU is budgeted; Docker deployments grant the app CAP_SYS_PTRACE or Manager.New fails closed; New rejects unknown modes and execute requires a verified Isolation() report (InsecureAllowUnconfinedRuntime opts out); MaxParallel counts in-flight spawns; the restart record is host-owned; artifacts are collected through O_NOFOLLOW directory descriptors under a per-session gate; DonePayload.Error keeps the first error under backpressure.
